fields.summary_ko.0: Following Nvidia Corp. (NVDA)'s Q3 beat and fiscal 2028 revenue guidance raise, neo-cloud operators Nebius (NBIS), IREN ltd. (IREN), and CoreWeave (CRWV) each rose 10%, 10%, and 9% respectively.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia disclosed $3.2B in neo-cloud commitments (down $400M from Q2) and $11.8B in total commitments, with new CEO Colette Kress emphasizing future investments will be conducted in a 'selective and disciplined' manner.
fields.summary_ko.2: Nvidia committed $39B in future supply chain procurement (up from $27.9B in the prior quarter), with multi-year memory supply procurement being the primary driver of increase.
